title: CQRV hardware profile, schema v1.0.0
description: Report §3.1.3, §3.3.2–3.3.3 (ρNISQ, Table 3.5); DECISIONS.md 2026-10-26 (Stage 11b, decision 1). Read by `cqr certify --profile` (CQRV.Certify.Profile, which enforces the same rules). Every figure is a natural number (durations in ns) or null; null means the source gives no figure or the component is not limiting (Table 3.5's native T-count). Every numeric field has a non-empty `source` entry saying where the figure comes from (a citation or a report section); no figure is invented. The figures are declared, not calibration data: routing, native gates and calibration are outside the trust boundary (§5.3.1).

budget.description: Report §3.3.2: the budget b of the fibre-membership test r ≤ b; null = not limiting (not compared).

t_gate_ns.description: typical two-qubit gate duration t_gate of ρNISQ

t1_ns.description: coherence time T1 from which the depth budget is derived

p_bar.description: Mean per-operation error p̄ of δ_hw ≤ δ + G·p̄ (§3.3.3), an exact unsigned decimal in [0, 1], or null.
